newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA-EVEA PANK MAY PROFIT 1.2 MLN KROONS.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA-EVEA PANK MAY PROFIT 1.2 MLN KROONS.

text.p: EVEA Pank, one of the smallest banks, said on Tuesday that it profit in May was 1.2 million kroons compared to April's 1.3 million kroons.
The bank said in a statement that its total profit for the first five months of the year was 5.8 million kroons.
The bank's balance sheet grew from 389.87 million kroons to 513.9 million kroons during the first five months of the year, an increase of 124.1 million kroons or 31.8 percent.
In May, deposits grew by 8.4 percent or by 29.4 million kroons and from the beginning of the year deposits grew by 30.7 percent, the bank added in a statement.
Short-term and savings deposits grew by 14 million kroons or by 6.7 percent in May.
The bank's loan portfolio was 233.5 million kroons in May, a decrease from April's 235.6 million kroons.
The loan portfolio formed 45.5 percent of the bank's assets, the bank added.
